texts.content: {"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 29], "size": 6.25, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.2}]}], "text": "唰的一下，大字同时压屏：\n吉隆坡武吉到马六甲的海上清真寺。"}
texts.text_zh: 唰的一下，大字同时压屏：吉隆坡武吉到马六甲的海上清真寺。

texts.content: {"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 33], "size": 6.25, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.2}]}], "text": "暮色里的白色尖拱撞进我眼里，暖灯亮起，\n黄橙条纹的巨型鼓也入了镜。"}
texts.text_zh: 暮色里的白色尖拱撞进我眼里，暖灯亮起，黄橙条纹的巨型鼓也入了镜。

texts.content: {"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 34], "size": 6.25, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.2}]}], "text": "再切到阴天，我沿礁石和栈桥慢慢走，\n彩绘廊桥接着金色穹顶和白色拱门。"}
texts.text_zh: 再切到阴天，我沿礁石和栈桥慢慢走，彩绘廊桥接着金色穹顶和白色拱门。

texts.content: {"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 29], "size": 6.25, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.2}]}], "text": "有人停下远眺，灰绿海面平着，小艇轻晃，\n白色邮轮缓缓划过。"}
texts.text_zh: 有人停下远眺，灰绿海面平着，小艇轻晃，白色邮轮缓缓划过。

texts.content: {"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 17], "size": 6.25, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.2}]}], "text": "我站在栈桥上，把安静收进这趟旅行🌊"}
texts.text_zh: 我站在栈桥上，把安静收进这趟旅行🌊
